subject: english
question:
Identify the part containing a grammatical or structural error:

The manager together with his staff have gone for lunch.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the sentence is "**The manager**," which is singular.
 
• When a singular subject is followed by a phrase such as "together with," "along with," or "as well as," the verb agrees with the singular subject.
 
• The verb "**have**" is incorrect because it implies plural agreement. It should instead be "**has**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The manager, together with his staff, has gone for lunch."*
